<!-- Provide a more detailed description of the PR, other things fixed or any additional comments/features here -->
## Detailed Description of the Pull Request / Additional comments
The order of destruction is incorrect:
Construction: 1. XamlApp, 2. XamlIsland
Destruction: 1. XamlApp, 2. XamlIsland, it should be 1. Xamlsland, 2. XamlApp

<!-- Describe how you validated the behavior. Add automated tests wherever possible, but list manual validation steps taken as well -->
## Validation Steps Performed
Manually debugged that the Xaml core is de-initialized correctly.

issue_context.title: [~75% IMPACT] Terminal still crashes on exit because of XamlApplication
issue_context.body:
The windows will stay like this for a few seconds.It should close immediately.
![屏幕截图(59)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52039820/59959373-997de900-94e8-11e9-80db-630fc8bef244.png)
What'more , I have found a closed issue which says that this bug should have been fixed.

I'm now using 10.0.18362.175 ,and my copy of Terminal is from the Store.
comments: Yeah this is definitely #1339, not totally fixed. Thanks.
It looks like my fix was incomplete, but I got it from @ocalvo's pull request.
Apparently this issue is still happening, so we're reactivating this

If I click the close button in the window header, it closes cleanly.

If I type `exit` at a PS prompt, it does the hanging-frame thing for a second or so.

Windows Terminal (Preview)
Version: 0.2.1831.0

Windows 10.18362.175 (1903)
Same thing as @tathamoddie upon typing `exit` it takes a while before actually closing the terminal. On the other hand, when you close it from the header, it closes seamlessly.
